candidate_basis: five candidates prioritized by the retained Boltz-2 ensemble case plus the KN035 parent control

stages.name: expression and sample quality
stages.decision_rule: Do not interpret weak binding for a sample that fails identity or monodispersity checks.

stages.name: direct binding by BLI
stages.proposed_setup: biotinylated human PD-L1 extracellular domain on streptavidin sensors; monomeric VHH in solution
stages.note: Concentrations and immobilization format are proposed for this plan and require pilot optimization.

stages.name: cell-surface orthogonal check
stages.proposal: flow cytometry on PD-L1-positive and matched PD-L1-negative cells, with viability and isotype controls

decision_sequence: Review sample quality before affinity ranking.
Require interpretable sensorgrams and acceptable residuals before quoting kinetic constants.
Compare direct binding with competitive inhibition; discordant candidates require investigation.
Advance candidates only after a cell-surface specificity check.
